Manifold 3.3.2, from the official npm package manifold-3d@3.3.2.
Upstream: https://github.com/elalish/manifold
License: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE included).

manifold.js and manifold.wasm are unmodified upstream files. The npm archive's
SHA-512 integrity was checked against the registry's dist.integrity metadata.
The unthreaded WebAssembly engine runs entirely in the browser. No CDN, server
conversion, SharedArrayBuffer, or cross-origin isolation is required.
